answer: Delayed vesting with clawback drains Sybil profits. Rewards an agent earns are not paid out at once; they sit in escrow and vest slowly over many epochs. If later audits link the agent to a ring of fakes, every unvested reward is clawed back to the shared reef that funds honest work. An attacker hoping to sip quick nectar from a lagoon of fake identities must keep each one alive and clean for months, paying ongoing compute while its payouts stay at risk the whole time.
